messages:
DeployBot: Heads-up: schema migration `mig_add_external_id` scheduled in 45m. Mode: tenant-wave backfill, adaptive caps. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/mig_add_external_id
Lena Park: Are waves based on tenant size buckets or hash?
Diego Rivera: Hash buckets. avoids hot tenant groups.
Ava Singh (oncall): If p99 > 350ms for 3m I'll pause. Who has pause perms?
Owen Wright: Oncall + release leads can `/deploybot pause` or `/deploybot abort`. Pause stops new waves, abort rolls back to last checkpoint.
Lena Park: Propose ROW_LIMIT=100k and QUIET_WINDOW=2h after finish for validate pin.
Diego Rivera: Agree. also set RETRIES=1 to avoid long retries in-wave.
DeployBot: Checkpoints created after each wave as `mig_add_external_id_cp_<n>`. Rollback instructions in runbook.
Ava Singh (oncall): I'll be at my desk. please keep messages terse so I can triage. :eyes:
Lena Park: Pinning api-service@v2.14.3 for 2h post-backfill.
DeployBot: 10m warning: migration starts in 10 minutes.
DeployBot: Migration started. wave=1 tenants=80 target_rows=100000 checkpoint=mig_add_external_id_cp_1.
Diego Rivera: wave1 ok. latency flat.
DeployBot: wave=2 had a retry on tenant 12, checkpoint remains cp_1 until retry succeeds. retry scheduled in 30s.
Diego Rivera: retry succeeded; cp_2 created.
DeployBot: Migration complete. final_checkpoint=mig_add_external_id_cp_final. Scheduling async NOT NULL validate in 24h.
Ava Singh (oncall): No pause/abort. marking monitoring clear. thanks. :tada:
